advisories.claim: Lines 13 and 15 use bare model ids "astra" and "terra", while every other Codex model id in the diff is gpt-5.6-<tier> (role files, dogfood config). Nothing in the repo confirms these ids load in Codex, and fallback_subagent_model / fallback_subagent_reasoning_effort are not verified against Codex's documented config keys.

The tracked dogfood copy sets lead gpt-5.6-terra (line 12) and fallback gpt-5.6-luna (line 14). The template and the brief say Astra lead and Terra fallback, so the native copy disagrees with the template it mirrors (docs/README.md says a mismatch is stale).

The new rule is hand-added to AGENTS.md (hunk at line 100), which CLAUDE.md says is generated and never hand-edited. CLAUDE.md is absent from the candidate diff, so the diff alone leaves sha256(CLAUDE.md) != sha256(AGENTS.md) and check would fail on it. The builder's working tree evidently has the matching CLAUDE.md edit; the handoff should include it.
CLAUDE.md requires template changes to be mirrored in the describing playbook (new-project.md, retrofit.md) in the same commit. CURRENT_CHECKPOINT.md admits this was not done.

The reader only accepts a bare double-quoted scalar ending at end of line. A trailing comment, a single-quoted literal string, an escaped quote, or a one-line triple-quoted value is read as missing, producing a false top-level gap. None of this is tested; the role files in the repo do not trigger it.
check now exits 1 on any repo without .codex/ (config and four role files missing). That is a behaviour change for Claude-only projects; the diff does not say this is intended, and no test covers it.

tests: Covers config template values, role template name/description, init install and no-overwrite without --force, check and retrofit gaps for missing config, missing role file and missing metadata, retrofit write-nothing, top-level-only reads (table header and multi-line body cases), and this repo passing check. Misses: trailing-comment and single-quoted forms, empty-description value on a role file, a Claude-only repo, and the retrofit 25-check pin staying exact after the docs/README slot change (relies on the existing pin).
brief_mistakes: The brief does not cite the ask-first rule for templates/.codex/agents/*.toml and the tools/jumpstart.py limit constants (it asks for edits to them directly), does not say whether a repo without .codex should be a gap for check, does not give the Codex model ids (it says Astra/Terra while the repo uses gpt-5.6-*), and does not require the playbook mirror that CLAUDE.md mandates.
lead_note: The AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md advisory is a harness artefact: run-task.sh excludes CLAUDE.md from diff.patch (it carries the orchestrator block), so Qwen's matching 7-line CLAUDE.md edit was hidden from the reviewer; appended to p2/diff.patch for the judge. Self-check in the worktree passed (12 checks, no gaps).
